EmailTemplate.name: Mosaic Direct - Order Error Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: Contract {!contractNumber} - Error Processing Your Order
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!customerName},
Apologies, your recent order did not process successfully. Our service team at Mosaic is actively working behind the scenes to resolve the issue and will reply to you promptly.
If you have urgent questions, please feel free to contact your SSR directly.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Internal ref: {!OrderNumber}
Please, do not reply to this email.
